# Pre-silicon characterization report

T1 item 8 summary: per-spec-row performance across conditions, with the evidence
record each verdict rests on. **Pre-silicon:** every figure is simulation, static
timing or place-and-route output; no bench or silicon data exists here (post-tape-out
bench data belongs elsewhere in `measurements/`). Verdicts are the live reading of
`spec/gap-to-submission.md`; the report neither relaxes nor re-grades the ratified spec.
Each number names the flow that produced it (LibreLane = Tiny Tapeout template flow;
klt = this program's flow). Every failing row's owner cell names the open issue
that would move its verdict, or the ratification it waits on (issue #524; the
generator validates shape offline -- openness was verified when the owner was
recorded).

## Fmax per corner

Flow: LibreLane (post-route OpenSTA), clock 20 ns, record librelane-corner-timing `20261011-144900-e5a0bae`. Fmax is an **estimate** derived as 1/(T - worst setup slack); the worst path at typ and fast is an I/O path, so treat those two as upper bounds.

| Corner | Worst setup slack (ns) | Worst hold slack (ns) | Implied Fmax (MHz) | Setup/hold met at 20 ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| nom_slow_1p08V_125C | +5.785 | +0.5602 | 70.3 | yes |
| nom_typ_1p20V_25C | +10.714 | +0.2611 | 107.7 | yes |
| nom_fast_1p32V_m40C | +11.074 | +0.0830 | 112.0 | yes |

Flow klt (OpenSTA): macro-backed netlist-estimate result produced by the fleet klt 0.9.2 (klayout-tools release v0.9.2, git commit 046ba74652fc; PIN_KLAYOUT_TOOLS_VERSION in 2AMLogic/2am infra/aws/batch-image-pins.env, read 2026-11-20), run in a throwaway uvx environment over IHP-Open-PDK commit f7bca32694fe3d58be0cc7d9df4b9f5db7161a14 (stamped from the run host's .pdk-store.json): setup at 20 ns closes at the 3 macro-characterized corners (worst +2.867 ns), hold fails at all 3 (worst -0.2266 ns, 23 violating endpoints each; no placement, CTS or hold repair), so 50 MHz is not shown to close on the klt flow. Every figure is byte-identical to the superseded klt 0.8.1.dev146 record (issue #394 re-mint, per #377); the record's Flow comparison now quotes the live LibreLane fast-corner hold +0.0830 ns (20261011-144900-e5a0bae pair), not the superseded +0.1156 ns (record sta-corner-sweep `20261120-031101-51b7eac` (+1 live)).

## Power

Dynamic power per corner: **no evidence**. No dynamic-power estimate exists in either flow. `klt sta` can report power from a routed netlist, but no routed klt netlist exists (the klt leg stops at a netlist estimate); the LibreLane runs behind the committed GDS do not commit a power report. No power spec row exists, so no budget is graded. (record sta-corner-sweep `20261120-031101-51b7eac` (+1 live)).

## Findings

- Row 7: the LibreLane flow places the macro-backed design inside the 2x2 core (58.55 %), yet the tracker keeps the row unmet because DR 0005 (SRAM macro) is unratified; the klt P&R leg's first placed measurement (die 161,592 um^2, 8.96 tiles at 41.83 % placed utilization, macro included, no PDN) exceeds the 2x2 budget at that utilization, and the report follows the tracker and does not pick either flow's number as the answer.
- Row 4: LibreLane reports 3 of the 6 declared corners as closing with 0 setup/hold violations; the klt netlist estimate closes setup but fails hold at the same 3 corners (pre-CTS, no hold repair). The flows differ on hold; this is a finding to record, not a number to pick from.

Rows not passing: 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12.
